caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of a deer lying on its side atop an oval-shaped base. The deer is rendered in shades of light gray with subtle darker gray shading along its body to suggest form and contour. Its snout is marked with a black nose, and the eyes are outlined with brown and black, giving them a strong contrast against the otherwise pale face. The inside of the deer’s ears is pinkish red, and atop its head is an antler or decorative crown-like structure in a warm tan-brown color. The base on which the deer rests is predominantly dark green with lighter green accents, creating the appearance of grass or vegetation, and is bordered along the bottom with solid black. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the focus entirely on the central figure. The artist's name, "NINA LOWRY," is written in the bottom left corner.
title: Deer Figurine
